description: Raw analytics stream, restaurant-selection and retired-parameter payload fixtures (contract v1.2, §23 and §24). Base path /analytics/ unless the endpoint says otherwise, auth X-API-Key, selector header X-Restaurant-ID (required).

fixtures.name: orders_stream_page
fixtures.description: One page of order headers for the selected restaurant (§23.4). aggregate_id is the bare Petpooja order ID and is NOT unique across restaurants.

fixtures.name: orders_stream_page_empty
fixtures.description: A caught-up page. cursor.cursor is null, so the client must keep its own cursor rather than store this one (§23.5).

fixtures.name: order_items_stream_page
fixtures.description: Order lines whose current parent header belongs to the selected restaurant. Lines carry order_line_key/line_index; there is no order_pk (§23.4).

fixtures.name: addons_stream_page
fixtures.description: Addon lines pointing at their exact parent line by parent_order_line_key plus line_index/addon_index. Two occurrences of one menu item stay distinguishable, which order_item_pk could never express (§23.4).

fixtures.name: discounts_stream_page
fixtures.description: Discount lines, linked to their order by event_id only (§23.4).

fixtures.name: allowed_restaurants
fixtures.description: The desktop profile selector source. Both branches advertise the same active shared-Petpooja menu-group capabilities; internal sync_scope_key and credential_ref are never exposed (§23.6, §25.3).

fixtures.name: allowed_restaurants_ungranted
fixtures.description: A credential with no configured grant is authorized for no restaurant; there is no implicit default (§23.6).

fixtures.name: error_selector_missing
fixtures.description: No X-Restaurant-ID. The server never picks a restaurant for the caller (§23.2).

fixtures.name: error_selector_invalid
fixtures.description: Header present but blank after ASCII-space trimming (§23.2).

payload.error: X-Restaurant-ID must be a non-empty restaurant ID.

fixtures.name: error_restaurant_forbidden
fixtures.description: A valid credential asked for a restaurant it has no grant for. Returned whether or not the restaurant exists, so a credential cannot enumerate the registry (§23.2).

payload.error: This credential is not authorized for restaurant '9zz9zz9zz9'.

fixtures.name: error_unknown_restaurant
fixtures.description: The credential is granted a restaurant this deployment does not configure — an operator misconfiguration, not a client error (§23.2).

fixtures.name: error_invalid_page_parameter
fixtures.description: cursor and limit are integers; limit is at least 1 and clamped to 5000 (§23.5).

fixtures.name: error_invalid_api_key
fixtures.description: The analytics streams authenticate with X-API-Key, not the sync Bearer token. Checked before any selection (§23.4).

fixtures.name: error_sync_scope_forbidden
fixtures.description: The same selector rules on a /desktop-analytics-sync/ route: the shared Bearer token's grants come from SYNC_RESTAURANT_GRANTS (§4.2, §23.3).

payload.error: This credential is not authorized for restaurant '9zz9zz9zz9'.

fixtures.name: error_selector_in_query_string
fixtures.description: A selector-shaped query parameter is refused before the header is read. Ignoring it is the one silent case that matters: a header naming one restaurant and a query string naming another would be answered with the header's rows (§24).

payload.error: Restaurant selection uses the X-Restaurant-ID header, not the query string; remove restaurant_id.

fixtures.name: error_retired_query_parameter
fixtures.description: legacy and scope_key are refused on every scoped /desktop-analytics-sync/ route, before the selector resolves, so a client learns the real reason rather than a selector error (§24).

payload.error: Retired query parameter(s): scope_key. The restaurant selector decides the scope, and the legacy forecast payload no longer exists.
